Entry Models · Intermediate

ICT 2022 Model

The supplied playbook describes this model as a liquidity raid followed by displacement with MSS, then a retracement into the FVG for execution. It is commonly associated with the 2022 Mentorship.

Open interactive ICT Academy →Official ICT channel ↗Official playlists ↗

How to identify and use this concept

  1. Mark higher-timeframe and session liquidity pools before the active window.
  2. Wait for a raid of a relevant pool.
  3. Require displacement and a close through the selected opposing swing (MSS).
  4. Mark the FVG created by that displacement and define the retracement entry rule.
  5. Place invalidation beyond the raided extreme and target opposing liquidity.
Use as a complete sequence, not as a single FVG pattern. If a required step is missing, record no trade.

Common mistakes and limitations

Choosing the pool after the move; calling slow drift displacement; entering on the sweep alone; assuming audited edge.
